Introduction

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I2, which must be performed on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The technical specification of the 
pump power 0.37 kw-400v-50Hz

The 
first draft initiated & tested by eng. Abd El Mohsen Mohammed general manager of 
Nag Hammadi Hyd. PS, and certified by by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem HPGC 
inspection and quality control general director
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff 
 should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Stop pump and switch off the power supply
Close the outlet and inlet valves

Work to be Carried Out

Check the alignment of the 
pump.

Operate the pump to check 
the noise.

Check the key and bearing 
and change if 
need.

Check the time operate and 
stopping time (3 min).

Operate the pump and check 
the load current.
